warehouse_fire: Acrid smoke rises in a dream above your stores; Hephaestus looks away, and the flame lies in wait.
Rats leave your warehouses in broad daylight. What is hoarded beyond measure, fire claims.
An ember rolls out of the sacred hearth and no one picks it up: your granaries have never been so dry.
lawsuit: A herald calls your name in the agora, and citizens listen without a smile. The judges sharpen their sherds.
Dike turns her eyes from your house; they whisper that a complaint is being drawn up, and that the scales will tip.
Your neighbours count your riches aloud. Whoever rises too high summons the court before him.
artisan_desertion: Your craftsmen sing more softly at their work, and one of them looks at the road more often than at the bench.
Tools slip from hands for no reason in your workshops; a worker dreams of another master.
Athena Ergane no longer blesses your trades. The first to leave will not say farewell.
ship_lost: The foam draws your seal on the waves, then erases it; Poseidon does not love those who think they rule the sea.
A gull lands on your prow and will not leave it. The sailors make offerings in silence.
The winds of Aeolus quarrel over your sails in a dream. What the sea carries, the sea can take back.
